anomalies.observed: The gate node of T7 (IRLR2905 low-side N-MOSFET, the pump switch on H11) is pulled up to +3V3 through R12 (10k), not pulled down to GND. The gate is also driven directly from IO10 through R21 (100 Ω) and pulled low by T8's collector.
anomalies.expected: The equivalent gate pull-down on the other low-side pump switch, R52 (10k, /NET0012 to GND), sets the FET to its off state when the GPIO floats. A pull-up to +3V3 on an N-channel gate turns the pump on by default.

evidence.quote: (node (ref "R12") (pin "1") (pintype "passive"))  [listed in net /NET0023 with T7 pin 1 G]
(node (ref "R52") (pin "1") (pintype "passive"))  [listed in net GND, gate pull-down of T4 pattern]

anomalies.impact: The main pump gate may be held high whenever the T8 inverter is off, so the pump can run at boot or during a firmware fault, with uncontrolled dosing or circulation.

anomalies.observed: The EN pin (pin 2) of the TPS62933 buck converter U7 is marked no-connect and is not tied to VIN, a divider or a GPIO.
anomalies.expected: The TPS62933 enable pin should be driven or pulled to a defined level (for example to VIN through a divider) so the 24 V to 5 V regulator has a defined enable state.
anomalies.impact: The 5 V rail may fail to start reliably or may be enabled or disabled unpredictably, which would affect the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO.
